messages:
maria: Heads-up — sampleapp's logs show request-id missing in traces after the new redaction hook landed. Repro in staging.
alex: saw that, looks like redaction may be trimming the entire header if it runs before the OTEL hook injects req-id.
sam: can you paste the logging init order? Especially where we call initRedaction() vs registerOtelHooks()
maria: here's minimal repro from node sampleapp:

```js
// init order
initLogging({ level: process.env.REDWOOD_LOG_LEVEL || 'info' })
initRedaction({ rules: ['authorization'] })
registerOtelHooks(app)
```

after moving initRedaction after registerOtelHooks the req-id appears.
alex: hmm, that matches. In python we call redaction first too. Could be an init race with async middleware.
maria: also noticed `x-request-id` gets replaced with `[REDACTED]` instead of removed — makes trace correlation fail.
telemetry-bot: alert: sampleapp-staging hit 20% reqid-missing rate in last 1h
sam: quick fix: ensure request-id middleware runs before redaction; for Node express use `app.use(requestId())` before redaction middleware.
alex: propose adding integration test that asserts req-id present in log entries and OTEL span attrs after init sequence.
maria: +1. I'll open a tiny PR to change init order and add a smoke test. assigning to @sam for review. :thumbsup:
sam: will review today. Also adding a note to devex onboarding doc about ordering caveat.
alex: can we also tweak redaction rule to not destroy headers but replace with `[REDACTED_HDR]` to preserve span attr presence?
maria: good call. minimal change keeps correlation and meets redaction.
telemetry-bot: deploy bot: staging redeploy queued by maria/telemetry-fix
maria: thanks — will follow up with PR link shortly.
